expect.name: Silver-Skagit Road (Skagit Valley Road) from Hope, British Columbia
expect.status: Unpaved for its full ~37 miles / 60 km. Maintained and graded periodically, but washboard and potholes are the norm and every source advises carrying a spare tire. Rebuilt after the 2021 B.C. flood washouts. As of 24 July 2026 DriveBC listed it CLOSED at km 6, past Silver Lake, because the Border 2 Fire - burning 2.4 km east of Hozomeen in Washington - had crossed the border into British Columbia.
expect.driveNote: Trans-Canada Hwy 1 Exit 168 at Hope, then Flood-Hope Road to Silver-Skagit Road and south on gravel. About 1 to 1.5 hours to the far end. Skyline II trailhead is near km 55 (about 34 miles in); Hozomeen Campground and the Hozomeen Lake trailhead are at the very end. A passenger car handles it when freshly graded; ground clearance helps when it is not.
expect.seasonalGate: B.C. closes Silver-Skagit Road for a seasonal winter shutdown, posted for 15 October 2025 to 14 April 2026. Separately and more importantly, the NPS gate at the international boundary at Hozomeen is closed until further notice, with vehicle and foot traffic across the border there prohibited; the crossing has never been staffed and is camera-monitored.

expect.fees: No climbing or parking fee; the NPS wilderness permit for Ross Lake NRA camps carries a fee.
expect.rules: USFS wilderness group-size limits apply once inside Pasayten Wilderness (max 12 people/18 head of stock). The lower Lightning Creek/Freezeout Creek approach corridor lies within Ross Lake National Recreation Area (North Cascades National Park Service Complex) before crossing into Pasayten Wilderness (Okanogan-Wenatchee NF); NPS regulations (designated-camp food storage, campfire restrictions at elevation, etc.) govern that stretch. Pack out all waste; practice Leave No Trace.
expect.permit: Overnight camping on the Ross Lake NRA portion of the approach (Lightning Creek Trail) requires an NPS backcountry/wilderness permit, reservable in advance on Recreation.gov ($6 reservation fee plus $10/person/night camping fee, ages 15 and under free) or picked up as a walk-up at the Wilderness Information Center in Marblemount. Once past the wilderness boundary into the Pasayten Wilderness (USFS) portion, a free self-issued wilderness permit applies. If approaching via Manning Park/Monument 78, crossing into the US on foot outside a sanctioned port of entry is not lawful; there is no permit for entering the US on the trail, so parties cannot walk across at the monument.
expect.closures: NPS reports the Hozomeen border gate is CLOSED — vehicle and foot traffic across the US/Canada border there is prohibited until further notice, closing off the Silver-Skagit Road driving approach. On the Canadian side, Silver-Skagit Road also has a seasonal closure roughly Oct 15-Apr 14.
expect.landManager: Mixed jurisdiction: Ross Lake National Recreation Area / North Cascades National Park Service Complex (NPS) on the lower Lightning Creek approach, transitioning into Pasayten Wilderness, Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest (Methow Valley Ranger District) for the upper mountain and summit.
expect.parking_pass: None needed at the Ross Dam trailhead.
expect.passRequired: No Northwest Forest Pass is needed at the NPS Ross Lake trailheads — a paid NPS wilderness permit (Recreation.gov) is required there instead. A Northwest Forest Pass may be needed for parking if using a USFS trailhead on the PCT/Manning Park approach option.

Added: Ptarmigan order 06-17-04-26-39 closes trails #498 Buckskin Ridge, #472 West Fork Pasayten, #474 Eureka Creek, #484.1 Shellrock, #484 Monument Creek north of Lake of the Woods — both approaches in the row's own approach text use them.

expect.name: Holden Village access (boat + shuttle) — currently closed
expect.driveNote: No direct road access; normally reached via the Lady of the Lake ferry up Lake Chelan plus a shuttle to Holden Village. As of 2026, Holden Village and Forest Road 8301 are closed indefinitely (2025 flood/landslide damage, not expected to reopen before 2027 per USFS/Holden Village), so the remaining line is the Phelps Creek Trailhead over Spider Gap. That is not a drive-to alternative either: FR 6200 is gated at milepost 18.2 past Atkinson Flat under USFS order #06-17-07-2026-11, cutting off both the Phelps Creek and Trinity trailheads, so the Spider Gap approach itself now begins with several miles of closed road.

value.name: Holden Village access (boat + shuttle) — FR 8301 closed through December 31, 2027
value.driveNote: No direct road access; normally reached via the Lady of the Lake ferry up Lake Chelan plus a shuttle to Holden Village. Forest Road 8301 to Holden Village and the Lucerne commercial dock are closed under Forest Service order 06-17-05-26-04, in effect January 28, 2026 through December 31, 2027, after December 2025 storm damage, so the remaining line is the Phelps Creek Trailhead over Spider Gap. That is not a drive-to alternative either: FR 6200 is closed from Atkinson Flat Campground to Trinity under Forest Service order 06-17-07-2026-11, in effect May 20, 2026 through December 31, 2027, cutting off both the Phelps Creek and Trinity trailheads, so the Spider Gap approach itself now begins with several miles of closed road. On top of that, the Little Giant Fire closure (Forest Service order 06-17-07-2026-40, in effect September 3 through October 31, 2026) closes the Chiwawa River Road, the Phelps Creek Road and the Phelps Creek Trail, as well as FR 8301.

approach.expect: Standard approach is via Holden Village: Lady of the Lake ferry from Chelan or Fields Point Landing to Lucerne, shuttle to Holden, then roughly 8 miles up the Railroad Creek Trail to Lyman Lake. As of 2026, Holden Village and Forest Road 8301 are closed to all hikers and vehicles due to 2025 flood/landslide damage, with reopening not expected before 2027 at the earliest — the only current access to Lyman Lake is the longer Phelps Creek Trailhead approach over Spider Gap (roughly 11–12 miles one-way, glacier travel with ice axe required).
approach.value: Standard approach is via Holden Village: Lady of the Lake ferry from Chelan or Fields Point Landing to Lucerne, shuttle to Holden, then roughly 8 miles up the Railroad Creek Trail to Lyman Lake. Forest Road 8301 and the Lucerne commercial dock are closed under Forest Service order 06-17-05-26-04, in effect January 28, 2026 through December 31, 2027, after December 2025 storm damage — leaving the longer Phelps Creek Trailhead approach over Spider Gap (roughly 11–12 miles one-way, glacier travel with ice axe required), itself closed through October 31, 2026 by the Little Giant Fire closure (Forest Service order 06-17-07-2026-40) and reached only over closed road (Forest Service order 06-17-07-2026-11, through December 31, 2027).

wa_north_star_mountain_east_route.why: FR 8301 + Lucerne dock: order 06-17-05-26-04, effective Jan 28 2026 (order text; alert start date shows Jan 29) through Dec 31 2027 — still in force. FR 6200: order 06-17-07-2026-11 effective May 20 2026 through Dec 31 2027, closed from Atkinson Flats Campground to Trinity (the "milepost 18.2" figure is not in the order, so dropped). Little Giant Fire order 06-17-07-2026-40 (Sep 3 - Oct 31 2026) closes FSR 6200, 6211 Phelps Creek Rd, Phelps Cr Tr 1511, and FSR 8301. Removed the "per USFS/Holden Village" attribution. Also dated road.name and approach (both rendered; approach said Spider Gap was "the only current access", which the fire closure contradicts).
